G1_unambiguity.justification: The synchronization and transitive-connectivity requirements clearly define the same connectivity condition as the original.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input fields, edge-cost limits, output requirements, and the single-critical-register case are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Activating all protocols connects every register, and with exactly n−1 protocols this is equivalent to the original tree setting, while the required subset and minimum-cost objective are unchanged.

G4_naturalness.justification: The register-synchronization framing is coherent and readable, though some phrases such as “unconditionally hold the same data state” are slightly more contrived than standard problem wording.
